ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure is a rigid norbornene-like bicyclic alkene skeleton, and there is a C=C double bond in the bicyclic system on the left; a pyrrolidine nitrogen substituent is connected below the bicyclic skeleton. On the right side is a six-membered heteroaromatic ring/diazine-like ring containing multiple nitrogen atoms, with N labeled on the ring, and intraring double bonds are drawn. There are three curved arrows in the figure: one points from the alkene region on the left to the upper position of the heterocycle on the right, one pushes π electrons within the heterocycle on the right, and another returns from below the heterocycle on the right to near the alkene on the left, indicating bond formation and double-bond migration after concerted electron rearrangement/cycloaddition. Reasoning: When processed according to the arrow directions, the π bond of the bicyclic alkene on the left participates with the π system of the nitrogen-containing heterocycle on the right to form a new fused ring connection; the π electrons in the heterocycle on the right migrate synchronously, making the heterocyclic double bonds in the product positioned as N=C and N=N. The pyrrolidine N substituent remains connected to the original bicyclic carbon, and the rigid stereochemical relationship of the bicyclic ring is retained according to the skeleton shown. Writing this final connectivity relationship and stereochemistry as SMILES gives [C@H]1(C2)CCC2C3[C@@]1(N4CCCC4)[C@H]5N=C[C@@H]3N=N5.

method.method_draft: First transcribe the reactant skeleton from the image, labeling the two alkene carbons on the left bicyclic system and the corresponding reactive carbons/nitrogens in the right heteroaromatic ring. Keep the pyrrolidine N substituent attached to the same bicyclic carbon and keep the rigid bicyclic stereochemistry from the drawing. method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中左侧是一个刚性的降冰片烯样双环烯烃骨架，左侧双环系统中有一个 C=C 双键；双环骨架下方连接一个吡咯烷氮取代基。右侧是含多个氮原子的六元杂芳环/二嗪样环，环上标有 N，并画有环内双键。图中有三条弯箭头：一条从左侧烯烃区域指向右侧杂环上方位置，一条在右侧杂环内推动 π 电子，另一条从右侧杂环下方回到左侧烯烃附近，表示协同电子重排/环加成后的成键与双键迁移。

推理：按箭头方向处理时，左侧双环烯烃的 π 键参与与右侧含氮杂环的 π 系统形成新的稠合环连接；右侧杂环中的 π 电子同步迁移，使产物中杂环双键定位为 N=C 和 N=N。吡咯烷 N 取代基保持连接在原来的双环碳上，双环刚性立体关系按图示骨架保留。将该最终连通关系和立体化学写成 SMILES，得到 [C@H]1(C2)CCC2C3[C@@]1(N4CCCC4)[C@H]5N=C[C@@H]3N=N5。
